audio.py.summary: The Audio class models the HP Experience (HPX) rebranding audio control features for test automation. It provides a structured set of methods for verifying and interacting with audio control cards and screens, including element presence checks, click actions, status validation for toggle buttons and cards, and text validation against string maps for internationalization. The class follows the page object model, separating UI element interaction from state verification, and includes comprehensive methods for screen dismissal and navigation via the learn more link.
